import pandas as pd

# Load the spreadsheet
file_path = '/mnt/data/spreadsheet/8942/1_8942_init.xlsx'
xls = pd.ExcelFile(file_path)

# Read the sheets
df_overview = pd.read_excel(xls, 'Overview')
df_pay_dates = pd.read_excel(xls, 'Pay Dates')

# The instruction says A2 is the data validation list. 
# In the provided data extent for 'Overview', row 0 is the header.
# Row 1 (index 0 in df_overview) is Date, Paycheck 1, Paycheck 2.
# A2 corresponds to df_overview.iloc[0, 0].
selected_date_val = df_overview.iloc[0, 0]

# Convert selected_date_val to datetime to extract month and year
selected_date = pd.to_datetime(selected_date_val)
selected_month = selected_date.month
selected_year = selected_date.year

# Convert 'Pay Dates' Date column to datetime
df_pay_dates['Date'] = pd.to_datetime(df_pay_dates['Date'])

# Filter 'Pay Dates' for the same month and year
mask = (df_pay_dates['Date'].dt.month == selected_month) & (df_pay_dates['Date'].dt.year == selected_year)
monthly_data = df_pay_dates[mask]

# Calculate the total of all paychecks (Paycheck 1 + Paycheck 2) for that month
total_paychecks = monthly_data['Paycheck 1'].sum() + monthly_data['Paycheck 2'].sum()

# The target is 'Overview'!B5.
# In df_overview:
# Row 0 (index 0): Date, Paycheck 1, Paycheck 2 (A2, B2, C2)
# Row 1 (index 1): NaN, NaN, NaN (A3, B3, C3)
# Row 2 (index 2): Total Bi Weekly..., 2000.0, NaN (A4, B4, C4)
# Row 3 (index 3): Total Monthly..., NaN, NaN (A5, B5, C5)
# So B5 is df_overview.iloc[3, 1]

# Update the value
df_overview.iloc[3, 1] = total_paychecks

# Save the modified spreadsheet
with pd.ExcelWriter('/mnt/data/outputs/8942_0_cddea86c/1_8942_output.xlsx', engine='openpyxl') as writer:
    df_overview.to_excel(writer, sheet_name='Overview', index=False)
    df_pay_dates.to_excel(writer, sheet_name='Pay Dates', index=False)

print(f"Calculated total for {selected_date.strftime('%B %Y')}: {total_paychecks}")
